name: Everything Spice" Baked Tofu Rice Bowl with Avocado, Tomatoes & Dill
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture. Set aside.
Place mayo and Dijon in another small bowl. Stir to combine the Dijon mayo.
Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu to one half of the baking sheet. Season both sides with salt.

Spread half of the Dijon mayo over the top side of the tofu, then sprinkle with half of the spice mixture (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining Dijon mayo and spice mixture. (Reserve spice bowl for later use.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Add tomatoes to the other half of the baking sheet with the tofu. Drizzle with oil and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring tomatoes halfway through, until tofu is golden and tomatoes are blistered in spots, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into the reserved bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Top with tofu, roasted tomatoes, avocado, and capers, then drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
